write_up: Your resume tells the story of a Mathematics Teacher at Pinewood Middle School and Cedar Creek High School who is building digital learning work alongside classroom teaching. I read it for Mathematics Teacher roles: the courses and class sizes make your current work easy to understand, while the Canvas module gives the design direction something concrete.

The line about teaching Algebra II and AP Statistics is a useful model because it names both the subjects and the students you teach. Your experience comes before education, and the certificate is clearly marked as in progress. The main question left in the Cedar Creek role is what your department’s professional learning community works on.
